segments.text: First, use the exact headline from the review note I'm highlighting here.
Between these two hero actions, make this one the only filled button and leave the other one outlined.
On phones, hide this navigation item completely, but keep the rest.
In this assurance row, move this item immediately before that one.
At phone width, the proof cards spill the whole page sideways. Keep all three cards, but make the page fit without horizontal scrolling.
Finally, on this same filled action, keep the label white on hover and keyboard focus, and give focus a clearly visible ring.

moments.caption: A Flare marks a temporary review note reading ‘Move work forward without another meeting.’ as the replacement hero H1.
moments.text: Move work forward without another meeting.

moments.caption: A Flare identifies ‘See how it works’ as the hero action that should remain filled; ‘Start free’ should be outlined.
A Flare identifies the ‘Resources’ navigation link as the only item to hide below 640 CSS pixels.
A motion gesture moves ‘Cancel anytime’ immediately before ‘No credit card’ while preserving all assurance items.
At 390 CSS pixels, the three-card proof grid forces page-wide horizontal overflow.
The pointer rests on ‘See how it works’ in its low-contrast hover state; the requested state keeps white text and adds a visible keyboard-focus ring.
